---

## 1. Company Overview

White Eagles & Co. is a premium digital agency based in Slovakia, specializing in **Web Development**, **Digital Marketing**, and **Business Automation**.

### Philosophy
We solve business problems, not just write code. Our key differentiator is **"No Complex Specs Required"**. We understand that business owners shouldn't need to write 50-page technical documents. We take the lead, proposing the best solutions based on a brief discussion of your goals.

### Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Modern CSS3 (responsive flex/grid layouts).
- **Backend & Automation**: Python, PHP.
- **CMS**: Custom solutions, WordPress (for specific legacy needs).
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4 (Server-side), Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity.

---

## 2. Detailed Service Offerings

### A. Web Development
*URL: /sk/service/webdev*

We build high-performance, SEO-ready websites tailored to the Slovak market.
- **Types**: Corporate websites, Landing pages, E-commerce, Booking systems.
- **Key Features**:
  - Multilingual support (SK, EN, RU, UA, etc.).
  - Custom Admin Panels.
  - Integration with CRM and Email systems.
  - **Guarantee**: 6 months of free technical support.

### B. Advertising Campaigns (PPC)
*URL: /sk/service/ads*

Contextual and Targeted advertising in Google and Meta ecosystems.
- **Google Ads**: Search, Display, Merchant Center (Shopping).
- **Meta Ads**: Facebook, Instagram, Threads, WhatsApp.
- **Process**:
  - Competitor Analysis & Math-based Budgeting.
  - Creative Design & Copywriting.
  - Continuous Optimization & Scaling.

### C. Telegram Bots & Automation
*URL: /sk/service/telegram*

Custom Python-based bots to automate routine tasks.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Auto-posting listings to portals (e.g., Bazoš).
  - Order & Reservation Management.
  - Data Parsing & Competitor Monitoring.
  - Customer Support &Feedback loop.

### D. Web Analytics & Tracking
*URL: /sk/service/analytics*

Advanced tracking setup to understand every user interaction.
- Server-Side Google Tag Manager (GTM).
- Google Analytics 4 (GA4) with custom events.
- Heatmaps (Microsoft Clarity / Yandex Metrica).

### E. Bug Fixing & Maintenance
*URL: /sk/service/bugfix*

Rescue services for broken or slow websites.
- Fixing PHP/JS errors.
- Malware removal & Security hardening.
- Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals).

### F. Cookie Consent Mode V2
*URL: /sk/service/cookies*

Legal compliance without monthly fees.
- Custom banner development.
- Full Google Consent Mode v2 integration.
- Ensuring data collection remains legal and effective.

### G. IT Blog & Knowledge Base
*URL: /sk/blog*

Guides on web development and on running a business in Slovakia. The complete
list with titles is in section 6 below.

## 3. Portfolio and case studies

Each project has its own page stating the brief, what was built and what
changed. Index: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/portfolio/ (replace `/sk/` with
`/ru/` for Russian).

- **Biliardovňa** - billiard club in Bratislava; online table booking replaced
  phone calls, and bookings through the site grew after launch.
  - https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/case/biliardovna/
- **Krása štúdio OK** - beauty salon in Ružinov; booking on the site is wired
  into Telegram, staff confirm with one tap and the slot closes automatically.
  Slovak, Russian and Ukrainian.
  - https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/case/studio-krasy/
- **TOP SKLAD** - warehouse rental; free space is visible online and booking
  runs through the site instead of a spreadsheet.
  - https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/case/top-sklad/
- **Synchro Žralok** - synchronised swimming club; bilingual site whose news
  feed is pulled automatically from the club's public Instagram.
  - https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/case/synchrozralok/
- **BODA BODA** - wholesale online shop for vanilla, coffee and cacao beans.
  - https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/case/bodabo/
- **TOP KOBKA** - storage box rental; sizes, terms and prices on the page.
  - https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/case/top-kobka/

## 4. Pricing & Policies

Prices are fixed per project and stated before the work starts.

- **Landing page**: from €1,500 - one service, one offer, a page for an ad campaign.
- **Company website**: from €3,500 - several services, portfolio, blog, multiple languages.
- **Online shop**: from €5,000 - catalogue, cart, payment and delivery.
- **Hourly rate**: **€35/hr** for development work, **€25/hr** for advertising,
  analytics, cookie banners and Telegram bots.

Other services start lower and are quoted per task: Google Ads setup from
€1,000, analytics and tracking from €500, a Telegram bot from €500, a cookie
banner with Consent Mode v2 from €200.

What the price includes: a structure built around the client's business rather
than a template, responsive layout, working forms, domain and hosting setup,
the mandatory Slovak company details, a cookie banner with Consent Mode v2,
GA4 and Tag Manager with conversion tracking, basic SEO setup and Search
Console, and six months of technical support.

- **Delivery time**: 10 working days on average, 90% of projects within 15.
- **Payment Methods**: Invoice, Card, Crypto (USDT, BTC).
- **Invoicing**: a Slovak faktúra with IČO/DIČ, deductible as a business expense.
- **Support**: All developed projects come with a **6-month support guarantee**.
